scope: Read-only original frozen API37 guard/preparator/workflow and eight synthetic tests; no new tests or emulator execution.

original_test_version.note: This is the exact original test version read before the offline-fixture follow-up; the newer test is reviewed separately.

confirmed_integration_blocker.cause: The original test used os.environ["LUMO_ACTION_TEST_SOURCE"] unconditionally in setUpClass. Full scripts/tests discovery from existing callers without this new variable would fail before the two exact-action tests. The narrow new diagnostic workflow supplied the variable, so its eight-test PASS did not establish compatibility with those other callers.
confirmed_integration_blocker.status: Follow-up required; do not use the original test as a globally accepted integration.

guard_findings: The real executable SDK adb and exact emulator serial are used; the guard compares that pair with monitor provenance. It reads complete properties, PID before/after, system_server.start_count before/after, registration of input/settings/activity/package/window, and successful settings/provider, Android-package and window-manager commands.

SDK37, release17, nonempty fingerprint and boot_completed=1 are mandatory. Every failed or timed-out command prevents readiness. At least three successful observations must span at least 10 seconds within an additional 120-second budget. A coherent observed PID/start_count change fails instead of silently starting a fresh successful window.

No production guard path changes a boot property, supplies fake adb responses or installs an APK. The original action still executes its keyevent and animation settings after the added awaited guard, and unchanged action errors still reach original cleanup.

The preparator requires exact upstream Git HEAD, clean action source, six original file hashes and a clean actual probe checkout. It modifies only the mirrored TypeScript/compiled-JavaScript insertion point and records actual invoking workflow, probe revision/tree and file hashes. Original main, dependencies and LICENSE remain unchanged.

Neither generic helper hardcodes e3d or 76980 identity. The deliberately unchanged-APK diagnostic passes those values explicitly. The manifest labels APK/native identities caller-declared and still requires independent binary verification.

The startup monitor records raw all-buffer logcat and per-command stdout/stderr/exit/timeout data, is bounded to 450 seconds, and must be alive before and after readiness. Its normal and always() stop paths protect against PID reuse using process start ticks; always() upload preserves incomplete evidence.
upstream_fixture_note: These locally archived original files are raw material, not a local Git checkout. Hashes match the required a421 action bytes. Actual CI obtains a separate pinned Git checkout and the preparator checks its HEAD and cleanliness.

local_test_result_scope.claim: The original log records 8 tests,OK with explicit upstream fixture environment. This is synthetic contract evidence, not Android17 success.

limits: An earlier restart before the first coherent PID observation is not automatically rejected solely because start_count exceeds one; that condition is recorded and raw startup logs still need review.
Sampled readiness cannot guarantee no failure after the last sample; the original keyevent/settings and unchanged full app/runtime/identity gates remain mandatory.
This API37/release17 guard must remain scoped to the API37 job. No SDK35 substitution or app identity relaxation was observed.
No emulator boot, APK installation, physical Fold7 or performance success is claimed.
